title: Wringer delivery manifest
description: manifest.json of a `wring deliver` bundle — what a verified change became. Schema version wringer.delivery.v1. This is the only bundle in Wringer that describes writes to git, and it exists because the amended law 6 buys that power with receipts.

delivery_id.description: The delivery directory's name, YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS-<4 hex>.

mode.description: dry_run wrote the plan and touched git not at all. live means --send was typed by a human.

run_dir.description: The evidence bundle whose gates passed. An unverified change is refused a branch.

branch.description: The branch Wringer would create, or did. Never equal to base.

base.description: The branch the merge request targets, and the one delivery may never touch.

files.description: Paths the delivery would carry, relative to the repo root.

spec_sha256.description: sha256 of the wringer.spec.yaml that authorised this change, or null when no spec drove it. The approved: true in that file is the authority the whole build ran on, and nothing else records which spec it was.

branch.description: The branch actually created, or null — in a dry run, and in a live run that failed before creating it.

merge_request.description: Null when none was opened — including when the push landed and the forge refused, which is a real state and is recorded rather than hidden.
